events.title: Liar's Dice comes to the demo. See you all at Next Fest!
events.summary: See You at the Steam Next FestBilge Rats is part of Steam Next Fest this October, from the 19th to the 26th. We hope to see you all there. events.title: Thank You to All Those Who Played so Far! And What's New in the Demo
events.summary: Thank You!A big thank you to everyone who's played the Bilge Rats demo so far, and to everyone who's taken the time to tell us what they thought. We read all of it.What's New in the DemoWe've brought a few things over from the full game. It's still the first day with the tutorial jobs, but there's a lot more to do while you're out there. events.title: The Bilge Rats demo sets sail at the end of September
events.summary: The Demo is Nearly HereThe Bilge Rats demo goes live on Steam at the end of September, a little ahead of Steam Next Fest.It's the first day of the game, start to finish. You wake up in Crook's Haven owing money, pull a few jobs off the board, and take the ship out to earn it back. Then you try to get home before the evening storm starts putting holes in the hull.
